hero.title: Colophon
hero.description: A closer look at how this website was built, from the technologies and design choices to the small details behind the experience.

intro.paragraph1: This portfolio is a single-page application built with Vue and a component-first approach. Each page is composed of small, reusable components, supported by a typed API layer and TanStack Query for efficient data fetching and caching.
intro.paragraph2: The website supports both English and Indonesian, adapts to light and dark themes, and respects reduced-motion preferences. Animations enhance the experience without compromising accessibility or usability.

highlights.typedAndCached: Typed API layer with TanStack Query

typography.title: Typography
typography.sans: used for headings and body text, providing a clean and readable interface
typography.mono: used for code, dates, and elements that benefit from consistent character spacing

palette.title: Color Palette
palette.description: The website's color palette is inspired by Ikuyo Kita from Kessoku Band, drawing from her red hair, yellow-green eyes, golden uniform button, and maroon ribbon and shoes.

craft.title: Motion & Accessibility
craft.description: Theme transitions use the View Transitions API for smooth visual changes. Scroll and entrance animations respect the prefers-reduced-motion setting, ensuring the website remains accessible and comfortable to navigate.

source.title: Open Source
source.description: The source code for this portfolio is available on GitHub, including its components, styling, and design system. Feel free to explore how everything works.
